_readme: Unified agent (devlandingpage + gateway). Workspace = granted host mounts surfaced at ~/files/<name> (A9); memory is separate at workspace.root (mounted ~/.tonoman, A3). Skills mounted under ~/.claude/skills: register-business-card, list-projects, create-tunnel. allowed_tools adds WebSearch/WebFetch for dev + research. Tunnels are on-demand via the create-tunnel skill → substrate control channel (request/response files under the memory mount, A8); tunnel_bin = path to cloudflared. Copy to a git-ignored settings.json and fill the token. Container provisioning (mounts/ports/env) is currently a deploy step — see build/agent.
